docs.title: PyPasser
docs.text: Free, open-source CAPTCHA solver & anti-bot bypass library for Python. No paid APIs • No third-party subscription keys • Pure HTTP & Browser automation

docs.title: What is PyPasser?
docs.text:
PyPasser is a modern Python library designed to solve CAPTCHAs and clear anti-bot interstitial challenges. Its primary strength lies in solving headless, pure HTTP challenges — such as reCAPTCHA V3, GeeTest V4, and Lemin Cropped — without launching a browser or running a JavaScript engine.

For visual, audio, or browser-bound challenges (reCAPTCHA V2, Cloudflare Turnstile, Cloudflare Interstitials), PyPasser provides high-level browser automation integrations with built-in stealth engine support.

Every solver in PyPasser exposes both synchronous (solve()) and asynchronous (asolve()) interfaces and returns a standardized SolverResult.

docs.title: Solvers & Capabilities
docs.text: Target Category Method Browser Needed? Free / Local? reCAPTCHA V3 CAPTCHA Pure HTTP token forge or DOM hook No Yes reCAPTCHA V2 CAPTCHA Audio challenge + local Vosk ASR Yes Yes GeeTest V4 CAPTCHA Pure HTTP (all 8 risk types + voice fallback) No Yes Lemin Cropped CAPTCHA Pure HTTP + local Computer Vision No Yes Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA Checkbox interaction + token poller Yes Yes ARCaptcha CAPTCHA Pure HTTP (puzzle CV + Persian voice ASR) No Yes Cloudflare Interstitial Anti-Bot Headed stealth browser + cookie extraction Yes Yes ArvanCloud Interstitial Anti-Bot Pure HTTP JSFuck challenge decoder No Yes

docs.title: Quick Example (Pure HTTP)
docs.text:
Solve reCAPTCHA V3, GeeTest V4, or Lemin Cropped challenges in a few seconds without opening a browser:

reCAPTCHA V3 (HTTP)GeeTest V4 (HTTP)Lemin Cropped (HTTP) 
from pypasser.captcha import recaptcha

result = recaptcha.v3.solve(
    anchor_url="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor?ar=1&k=...&co=..."
)

if result.is_solved:
    print("g-recaptcha-response:", result.response_token)

from pypasser.captcha import geetest

# Auto-detects whether the site serves slide, ai, match, voice, etc.
result = geetest.v4.solve(
    captcha_id="54088bb07d2df3c46b79f80300b0abbe",
    risk_type="auto",
)

if result.is_solved:
    print("GeeTest seccode JSON:", result.response_token)

from pypasser.captcha import lemin

result = lemin.solve(
    captcha_id="CROPPED_3dfdd5c_d1872b526b794d83ba3b365eb15a200b",
    domain="https://2captcha.com",
)

if result.is_solved:
    print("Pre-validation token:", result.response_token["pv_token"])
    print("Answer payload:", result.response_token["answer"])
    print("Challenge ID:", result.response_token["challenge_id"])

docs.title: Key Highlights
docs.text:
• Zero Cost: Eliminates costly third-party CAPTCHA solving services (2Captcha, Anti-Captcha, CapSolver).
  • Headless HTTP First: Whenever mathematically possible, challenges are solved via direct wire protocols.
  • Stealth Browser Support: Native support for Patchright, Playwright, and Camoufox to beat browser fingerprinting.
  • Offline Machine Learning: Uses local computer vision (Canny edge detection, template correlation) and offline speech recognition (Vosk).

docs.title: Live Benchmark
docs.text:
PyPasser includes an automated live benchmark suite that tests every solver and anti-bot bypass against real live production endpoints, verifies the generated tokens with each demo's server verification API, and replays anti-bot clearance cookies over plain HTTP.

Two runner scripts are provided:

  • benchmark/run.py: Synchronous test harness.
  • benchmark/run_async.py: Asynchronous test harness.

docs.title: Anti-Bot Bypasses Overview
docs.text:
Modern web applications protect their infrastructure using anti-bot edge proxies (such as Cloudflare and ArvanCloud). Rather than showing an inline CAPTCHA widget, these systems intercept suspicious visitors with full-page interstitial challenge walls ("Just a moment...", JavaScript browser verification).

PyPasser provides specialized bypass modules that clear these walls and extract authenticated session tokens.

docs.title: Interstitial Bypasses Matrix
docs.text: Target Module Path Method Browser Needed? Clearance Output Cloudflare Interstitial pypasser.antibot.cloudflare Headed stealth browser + token click Yes (headed recommended) cf_clearance cookie + user_agent ArvanCloud Interstitial pypasser.antibot.arvancloud Pure HTTP JSFuck challenge decoder No (pure HTTP) __arcsjs cookie + user_agent

docs.title: The Cookie Replay Pattern
docs.text:
Both Cloudflare and ArvanCloud bind their clearance cookies to two parameters:

  1. The Client IP Address: The exit IP that solved the challenge.
  2. The User-Agent Header: The exact browser User-Agent string reported during clearance.

When PyPasser clears an anti-bot wall, it returns the cleared session cookies in result.cookies and the matching User-Agent string in result.user_agent. You then replay these values with any standard HTTP library (httpx, requests, aiohttp):

sequenceDiagram
    participant P as PyPasser Solver
    participant B as Anti-Bot Wall (Cloudflare/ArvanCloud)
    participant C as Plain HTTP Client (httpx)
    participant S as Protected Web Server

    P->>B: Solve Challenge (Browser or Pure HTTP)
    B-->>P: Issue Clearance Cookies (__arcsjs / cf_clearance)
    P-->>C: Return SolverResult(cookies, user_agent)
    Note over C,S: Same IP Address Replay
    C->>S: GET /api/data (Cookies + Bound User-Agent)
    S-->>C: 200 OK (Clean Page HTML / JSON)

docs.title: Python Replay Example
docs.text:
import httpx

# After clearing the wall with PyPasser:
result = solver.solve(...)

# Replay cookies over plain HTTP from the same IP:
headers = {
    "User-Agent": result.user_agent,
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
}

with httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies, headers=headers) as client:
    response = client.get("https://protected-site.com/protected-page")
    print("Bypassed status:", response.status_code)

docs.title: ArvanCloud Interstitial
docs.text:
ArvanCloud (arvancloud.ir) is a major Iranian CDN and cloud security provider. Its anti-bot protection intercepts visitors with an interstitial JavaScript challenge page.

PyPasser clears ArvanCloud challenges in a few seconds over pure HTTP. It parses the challenge page, extracts the JSFuck-obfuscated mathematical equations, decodes the required cookie values directly in Python without executing JavaScript, and submits the response over HTTP.

Zero browser, zero Node.js runtime.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
ArvanCloud solving is fully contained in PyPasser's core package:

pip install PyPasser

docs.title: Quick Example (Pure HTTP)
docs.text:
import httpx
from pypasser.antibot import arvancloud

target_url = "https://esale.ikco.ir/"

# 1. Clear the ArvanCloud challenge over pure HTTP
result = arvancloud.solve(
    url=target_url,
    timeout=30,
    attempts=3,
)

if result.is_solved:
    print("Cleared ArvanCloud challenge!")
    print("Cookies:", result.cookies)
    # Output: {'__arcsjs': '...', '__arcsjsc': '...'}

    # 2. Replay cookies over plain HTTP
    headers = {"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
    with httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies, headers=headers) as client:
        response = client.get(target_url)
        print("Replay status:", response.status_code)

docs.title: Async Example
docs.text:
import asyncio
import httpx
from pypasser.antibot import arvancloud

async def main():
    target_url = "https://esale.ikco.ir/"

    result = await arvancloud.asolve(target_url)

    if result.is_solved:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
            cookies=result.cookies,
            headers={"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
        ) as client:
            resp = await client.get(target_url)
            print("Status:", resp.status_code)

asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: asolve()
docs.text:

    url: str,
    proxy: Optional[str] = None,

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Default Description url str Required Any protected URL on the target site. proxy str \| None None Proxy URL string (http://, socks5://). Clearance is tied to the proxy IP. timeout int \| float 30 Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds. attempts int 3 Number of challenge/response round trips before giving up. user_agent str DEFAULT_UA Browser User-Agent header sent with requests.

docs.title: Return Value
docs.text:
Returns a SolverResult where:

  • is_solved: True when ArvanCloud sets clearance cookies.
  • cookies: Dictionary containing {"__arcsjs": "...", "__arcsjsc": "..."}.
  • user_agent: The User-Agent string used during clearance.
  • response_token: None.

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause ArvanBypassError Challenge could not be cleared within the attempt budget. ArvanChallengeError Challenge page HTML or JSFuck script could not be parsed or decoded. RequestFailed Network or HTTP connection error.

docs.title: Cloudflare Interstitial
docs.text:
Cloudflare protects websites with a full-page interstitial screen ("Just a moment...", 5-second challenge). When a browser passes this check, Cloudflare sets a session cookie named cf_clearance.

PyPasser's Cloudflare module automates this challenge page, clicks the verification checkbox if present, waits for the redirect, and extracts the cf_clearance cookie alongside the exact User-Agent.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
Cloudflare's bot heuristics detect standard headless automation flags. We strongly recommend Patchright or Camoufox:

pip install "PyPasser[stealth]"
patchright install chromium

docs.title: Quick Example (Headed Browser + HTTP Replay)
docs.text:
import httpx
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.antibot import cloudflare

target_url = "https://steamdb.info/"

# Step 1: Clear the Cloudflare interstitial using a headed stealth browser
with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto(target_url)

    result = cloudflare.solve(page, timeout=60)
    browser.close()

if not result.is_solved or not result.cookies.get("cf_clearance"):
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to clear Cloudflare wall")

print("Successfully cleared Cloudflare!")
print("cf_clearance:", result.cookies["cf_clearance"][:20], "...")

# Step 2: Replay the session over plain HTTP from the same IP:
headers = {"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
with httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies, headers=headers) as client:
    response = client.get(target_url)
    print("Replay status:", response.status_code)
    print("Page title:", response.text[:80])

docs.title: Async Example
docs.text:
import asyncio
import httpx
from patchright.async_api import async_playwright
from pypasser.antibot import cloudflare

async def main():
    target_url = "https://steamdb.info/"

    async with async_playwright() as pw:
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(target_url)

        result = await cloudflare.asolve(page, timeout=60)
        await browser.close()

    if result.is_solved:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
            cookies=result.cookies,
            headers={"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
        ) as client:
            resp = await client.get(target_url)
            print("Async HTTP replay status:", resp.status_code)

asyncio.run(main())

docs.text:
def solve(
    page: Any,
    backend: str = "auto",
    attempts: int = 3,
    timeout: Union[int, float] = 60.0,
) -> SolverResult: ...

docs.title: asolve()
docs.text:
async def asolve(
    page: Any,
    backend: str = "auto",
    attempts: int = 3,
    timeout: Union[int, float] = 60.0,

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Default Description page Page Required Playwright or Patchright Page on the challenge page ("Just a moment..."). backend str "auto" Browser automation backend: "auto", "playwright", or "patchright". attempts int 3 Maximum checkbox click attempts if the challenge re-renders. timeout int \| float 60.0 Total seconds to wait for clearance and page redirect.

docs.title: Return Value
docs.text:
Returns a SolverResult where:

  • is_solved: True when the challenge is successfully cleared and cf_clearance is acquired.
  • cookies: Dictionary of active cookies containing {"cf_clearance": "..."}.
  • user_agent: String containing the browser's navigator.userAgent.
  • response_token: String containing Turnstile response token if one was issued.

docs.title: Important Rules for Cloudflare Clearance
docs.text:
1. Headed Browser Recommended: Cloudflare's TLS fingerprinting, canvas noise checks, and CDP detection will block headless Chrome on high-security zones.
  2. IP Matching: You must perform your subsequent HTTP requests from the exact same egress IP that ran the browser session.
  3. User-Agent Matching: Always pass headers={"User-Agent": result.user_agent} on every request. Cloudflare checks that the User-Agent header matches the one hashed into cf_clearance.

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause CloudflareClearanceError Challenge appeared to pass but no cf_clearance cookie was set (IP soft-block or adapter cookie extraction failure). CloudflareError Base exception for Cloudflare clearance issues. UnknownBackend Could not determine the browser adapter type from page. BackendNotAsync Attempted asolve() using a synchronous Playwright page instance.

docs.title: Base & Transport Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description PyPasserError Root exception for all PyPasser errors. Catch this to handle any PyPasser failure. RequestFailed Network transport failure, HTTP error, timeout, or CDN unreachable. RequestRateLimited The remote server or mirror pool returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or 5xx errors. InvalidProxyURL Malformed proxy string or unsupported protocol scheme.

docs.title: Browser Automation Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description UnknownBackend Raised when backend="auto" could not identify the browser adapter from the provided page object. BackendNotAsync Raised when calling an asynchronous solver (asolve()) with a synchronous Playwright page instance.

docs.title: reCAPTCHA Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description InvalidAnchorURL The anchor URL is missing required query parameters (k, co), or neither/both page and anchor_url were provided. RecaptchaTokenNotFound The initial hidden recaptcha-token value was missing from the Google anchor response. RecaptchaResponseNotFound The rresp token was missing in Google's reload reply, or Page mode timed out waiting for #g-recaptcha-response. AudioDecodeError The downloaded audio challenge file could not be decoded or converted to raw PCM format. IpBlock Google blocked the IP address from requesting audio challenges ("automated queries" error).

docs.title: GeeTest Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description GeeTestError Base exception for GeeTest solver errors (e.g., unsupported or invalid risk_type). GeeTestSolveFailed Verification was rejected, CV matching failed, or the attempt budget was exhausted.

docs.title: Lemin Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description LeminError Base exception for Lemin cropped solver errors. LeminSolveFailed Cutout piece matching failed, pre-validation was rejected, or multi-piece puzzle was requested.

docs.title: ARCaptcha Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description ARCaptchaError Base exception for ARCaptcha errors, or missing site_key / domain parameters. ARCaptchaBlocked ARCaptcha server flagged or blocked the session (captcha_type == "block"). ARCaptchaSolveFailed Challenge could not be solved within the attempt budget.

docs.title: Anti-Bot Interstitial Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Class Description CloudflareError Base exception for Cloudflare interstitial clearance errors. CloudflareClearanceError Challenge passed but no cf_clearance cookie was set (indicates soft IP block or cookie extraction issue). ArvanChallengeError Challenge page HTML or JSFuck script could not be parsed or decoded. ArvanBypassError ArvanCloud challenge was not cleared within the attempt budget.

docs.title: Error Handling Best Practices
docs.text:
from pypasser.exceptions import (
    PyPasserError,
    IpBlock,
    RequestRateLimited,
    LeminSolveFailed,
)

try:
    result = lemin.solve(...)
except LeminSolveFailed as exc:
    print(f"Lemin challenge rejected: {exc}")
except RequestRateLimited:
    print("Rate limited by target API. Rotate proxy or back off.")
except IpBlock:
    print("IP blocked by Google. Switch proxy.")
except PyPasserError as exc:
    print(f"General PyPasser failure: {exc}")

docs.title: SolverResult Structure
docs.text: Every solver and bypass in PyPasser returns an instance of the frozen dataclass SolverResult. This provides a consistent, immutable response structure across both pure HTTP and browser automation solvers.

docs.title: Dataclass Definition
docs.text:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SolverResult:
    is_solved: bool
    response_token: str | dict[str, str] | None = None
    cookies: dict[str, str] | None = None
    user_agent: str | None = None

docs.title: is_solved (bool)
docs.text:
Indicates whether the challenge was successfully solved or bypassed.

  • Always check result.is_solved before reading response_token or cookies.
  • Solvers raise exceptions on catastrophic failures, but soft verification rejections may return is_solved=False.

docs.title: response_token (str | dict[str, str] | None)
docs.text:
Contains the token(s) to submit back to the protected site or form:

Solver Format Example Content reCAPTCHA V2 str "03AFcWeA..." (g-recaptcha-response) reCAPTCHA V3 str "03AFcWeA..." (g-recaptcha-response) Cloudflare Turnstile str "0.4jX9..." (cf-turnstile-response) ARCaptcha str "91e0a2b5-..." (arcaptcha-token) GeeTest V4 str (JSON) '{"captcha_id":"...","pass_token":"...","gen_time":"...","captcha_output":"..."}' Lemin Cropped dict[str, str] {"pv_token": "...", "answer": "...", "challenge_id": "..."} Anti-Bot Interstitials None (Anti-bots populate cookies instead)

docs.title: cookies (dict[str, str] | None)
docs.text:
A dictionary of session cookies (name -> value) issued upon clearing the challenge.

  • Populated by anti-bot interstitial bypasses (cf_clearance for Cloudflare, __arcsjs and __arcsjsc for ArvanCloud).
  • Replay these cookies in subsequent HTTP client calls (httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies)).

docs.title: user_agent (str | None)
docs.text:
The exact User-Agent string of the client or browser context that solved the challenge.

  • Cloudflare and ArvanCloud clearance cookies are cryptographically bound to the solver's User-Agent.
  • Always pass headers={"User-Agent": result.user_agent} when replaying clearance cookies.

docs.title: Pattern 1: Handling CAPTCHA Tokens
docs.text:
result = recaptcha.v3.solve(...)

if result.is_solved:
    token = result.response_token
    # Submit token with your form data
    client.post("https://example.com/api/login", data={"g-recaptcha-response": token})

docs.title: Pattern 2: Handling Dict Tokens (Lemin)
docs.text:
result = lemin.solve(...)

if result.is_solved:
    data = result.response_token
    pv_token = data["pv_token"]
    answer = data["answer"]
    challenge_id = data["challenge_id"]

docs.title: Pattern 3: Handling Anti-Bot Cookie Replay
docs.text:
result = cloudflare.solve(page)

if result.is_solved:
    headers = {"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
    with httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies, headers=headers) as client:
        response = client.get("https://example.com/data")

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: PyPasser is organized into a modular design. The core package is lightweight with minimal dependencies (httpx[socks] and cryptography), allowing you to install only what your application requires.

docs.title: Core Installation
docs.text:
Install the base package from PyPI:

pip install PyPasser

The base package supports:

  • reCAPTCHA V3 (Pure HTTP anchor URL mode)
  • ArvanCloud Interstitial (Pure HTTP JSFuck challenge clearance)

docs.title: Capability Extras
docs.text:
PyPasser defines optional dependency groups for specialized capabilities:

# Browser automation (Playwright)
pip install "PyPasser[browsers]"

# Stealth browser engines (Patchright + Camoufox) — Recommended for Turnstile & V2
pip install "PyPasser[stealth]"

# Speech-to-text recognition (Vosk + ffmpeg + pydub)
pip install "PyPasser[speech]"

# Computer vision & template matching (Pillow + NumPy)
pip install "PyPasser[vision]"

# All capabilities bundled
pip install "PyPasser[all]"

docs.title: Extras Requirement Matrix
docs.text:
Consult this table to determine which extras your target solver requires:

docs.title: Offline Speech Models (Vosk)
docs.text:
Solvers utilizing audio recognition (recaptcha.v2, arcaptcha, geetest.v4 voice) download their required Vosk language models automatically on the first run into ~/.cache/vosk/ or the local system cache.

  • English model: vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 (~40 MB)
  • Persian model: vosk-model-fa-0.5 (~1.4 GB, only for ARCaptcha voice)

Subsequent runs run completely offline from the local cache.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
PyPasser provides a consistent API across every solver:

  • Sync: solve(...)
  • Async: asolve(...)
  • Result: Always returns a SolverResult

docs.title: 1. Pure HTTP Solvers (Zero Browser)
docs.text: Pure HTTP solvers execute in a few seconds without launching any browser instance or Node.js runtime.

docs.title: Lemin Cropped CAPTCHA
docs.text:
from pypasser.captcha import lemin

result = lemin.solve(
    captcha_id="CROPPED_3dfdd5c_d1872b526b794d83ba3b365eb15a200b",
    domain="https://2captcha.com",
)

if result.is_solved:
    # Lemin returns pre-validation tokens in response_token dict:
    pv_token = result.response_token["pv_token"]
    answer = result.response_token["answer"]
    challenge_id = result.response_token["challenge_id"]
    print("Pre-validation token:", pv_token)

docs.title: GeeTest V4 (Auto-detect)
docs.text:
import asyncio
from pypasser.captcha import geetest

async def main():
    # Asynchronous solve with automatic challenge type detection
    result = await geetest.v4.asolve(
        captcha_id="54088bb07d2df3c46b79f80300b0abbe",
        risk_type="auto",
    )
    if result.is_solved:
        print("GeeTest seccode:", result.response_token)

asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: 2. Browser Automation Solvers
docs.text: For widgets that require a browser context, pass a Playwright or Patchright Page object.

docs.title: Cloudflare Turnstile
docs.text:
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import turnstile

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/cloudflare-turnstile")

    # Solves embedded or popup Turnstile widget
    result = turnstile.solve(page)

    if result.is_solved:
        print("Turnstile token:", result.response_token)
        # Form submission can proceed
        page.locator("button[type='submit']").click()

    browser.close()

docs.title: reCAPTCHA V2 (Audio Bypass)

from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import recaptcha

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/recaptcha-v2")

    # Automates checkbox click, audio download, and local Vosk transcription

    if result.is_solved:

docs.title: 3. Anti-Bot Clearance & HTTP Session Replay
docs.text:
Anti-bot modules clear interstitial walls ("Just a moment...", JS challenges) and return session cookies bound to the solver's User-Agent. You then replay these cookies over standard HTTP clients like httpx or requests.

import httpx
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.antibot import cloudflare

target_url = "https://steamdb.info/"

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto(target_url)

    # Solve Cloudflare 5s interstitial wall
    result = cloudflare.solve(page)
    browser.close()

if result.is_solved:
    # Replay session cookies over plain HTTP from the same IP:
    headers = {"User-Agent": result.user_agent}
    with httpx.Client(cookies=result.cookies, headers=headers) as client:
        response = client.get(target_url)
        print("Status code:", response.status_code)
        print("Page title:", response.text[:100])

docs.title: 4. Error Handling Pattern
docs.text:
Catch base PyPasserError or specific module exceptions:

from pypasser.exceptions import (
    PyPasserError,
    LeminSolveFailed,
    GeeTestSolveFailed,
    IpBlock,
)

try:
    result = lemin.solve(...)
except LeminSolveFailed as e:
    print(f"Lemin challenge could not be solved: {e}")
except PyPasserError as e:
    print(f"General PyPasser error: {e}")

docs.title: CAPTCHA Solvers Overview
docs.text: PyPasser supports all major commercial CAPTCHA providers through high-speed pure HTTP pipelines and stealth browser automation.

docs.title: Solvers Decision Guide
docs.text:
Use this guide to pick the appropriate solver for your target site:

flowchart TD
    A[Identify Target Challenge] --> B{Challenge Type?}
    B -->|reCAPTCHA V3| C[pypasser.captcha.recaptcha.v3]
    B -->|reCAPTCHA V2| D[pypasser.captcha.recaptcha.v2]
    B -->|GeeTest V4| E[pypasser.captcha.geetest.v4]
    B -->|Lemin Cropped| F[pypasser.captcha.lemin]
    B -->|Cloudflare Turnstile| G[pypasser.captcha.turnstile]
    B -->|ARCaptcha| H[pypasser.captcha.arcaptcha]

    C -->|Pure HTTP or DOM| C1[Returns g-recaptcha-response]

docs.title: Dual Sync & Async APIs
docs.text:
Every solver module exports both synchronous and asynchronous top-level functions:

  • solve(...)

docs.title: Standard Return Type
docs.text:
All solvers return a frozen SolverResult object: 

result = solver.solve(...)
if result.is_solved:
    token = result.response_token

docs.title: Proxy Support
docs.text:
HTTP-based solvers accept a standard proxy string across HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 schemes:

docs.title: ARCaptcha
docs.text:
ARCaptcha (arcaptcha.ir / arcaptcha.co) is the primary CAPTCHA provider used across Iranian websites, government services, banks, and e-commerce platforms.

PyPasser provides full support for ARCaptcha across all challenge types using pure HTTP and browser automation modes:

  • Puzzle Slider: Solved headlessly via local computer vision contour alignment.
  • 9-Grid Question: Automatically falls back to the Persian voice challenge.
  • Voice Challenge: Transcribed locally using an offline Persian Vosk ASR model.
  • Instant Challenges: Clears cookie and accept challenge types without user interaction.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
ARCaptcha utilizes computer vision for slider puzzles and speech recognition for Persian voice challenges:

pip install "PyPasser[vision,speech]"

docs.title: Quick Example (Pure HTTP)
docs.text:
from pypasser.captcha import arcaptcha

# Pure HTTP solve without opening a browser
result = arcaptcha.solve(
    site_key="d6ggpvy684",
    domain="demo.arcaptcha.co",
)

if result.is_solved:
    print("arcaptcha-token:", result.response_token)

docs.title: Quick Example (Page Mode with Playwright)
docs.text:
If you are already driving a browser session with Playwright, pass the page instance:

from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import arcaptcha

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://demo.arcaptcha.co/")

    # Solves the widget and populates the hidden input[name='arcaptcha-token']
    result = arcaptcha.solve(page=page)

    if result.is_solved:
        print("Token:", result.response_token)
        page.locator("#submit-btn").click()

    browser.close()

docs.title: GeeTest V4
docs.text:
GeeTest V4 is an enterprise-grade CAPTCHA suite featuring multiple interactive challenges and behavioral risk analysis.

PyPasser provides a 100% pure HTTP solver for the complete GeeTest V4 family. It communicates directly with GeeTest's /load and /verify endpoints, performs client-side RSA/AES cryptography, and computes proof-of-work (PoW) locally without any browser overhead.

docs.title: Supported Risk Types
docs.text:
GeeTest V4 assigns challenges based on risk scoring (risk_type):

risk_type Challenge Description Solving Strategy "auto" Auto-detects challenge type configured on the server Queries /load and dispatches appropriate solver "slide" Classic jigsaw puzzle slider Computer vision edge alignment + natural mouse trajectory "ai" Behavioral pass-through Instant PoW clearance "winlinze" 2-point or 3-point connector trail Natural cursor curve synthesis "match" Icon/symbol pair matching Template correlation "nine" 9-grid image recognition Automatic voice fallback via Vosk ASR "icon" Symbol / object recognition Automatic voice fallback via Vosk ASR "svg_icon" Vector graphic rotation/alignment Keyframe sweep + voice fallback "voice" Spoken digit audio challenge Headless offline speech recognition via Vosk

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
GeeTest V4 uses computer vision for puzzle matching and speech recognition for voice fallback:

pip install "PyPasser[vision,speech]"

docs.title: Quick Example (Auto-Detect)
docs.text:
from pypasser.captcha import geetest

# Pure HTTP solve in a few seconds:
result = geetest.v4.solve(
    captcha_id="54088bb07d2df3c46b79f80300b0abbe",
    risk_type="auto",
)

if result.is_solved:
    # response_token is a JSON string containing the seccode dictionary
    import json
    seccode = json.loads(result.response_token)
    print("Pass Token:", seccode["pass_token"])
    print("Captcha Output:", seccode["captcha_output"])
    print("Lot Number:", seccode["lot_number"])

docs.title: Browser Automation Integration
docs.text:
To validate a form protected by GeeTest V4 in Playwright or Selenium, inject the seccode object or submit it to the site's backend verification API:

import json
from pypasser.captcha import geetest

# 1. Solve headlessly via PyPasser HTTP
result = geetest.v4.solve(captcha_id="your_captcha_id")
seccode = json.loads(result.response_token)

# 2. Submit to the site's login/verify endpoint
response = client.post(
    "https://example.com/api/login",
    json={
        "username": "user",
        "password": "secretpassword",
        "captcha_id": seccode["captcha_id"],
        "lot_number": seccode["lot_number"],
        "pass_token": seccode["pass_token"],
        "gen_time": seccode["gen_time"],
        "captcha_output": seccode["captcha_output"],
    }
)

docs.title: Dynamic RSA Key Recovery
docs.text:
GeeTest signs challenge responses using RSA public keys shipped inside gcaptcha4.js. Occasionally, GeeTest rotates its keys or serves different keys across mirror domains.

PyPasser features an automatic dynamic key recovery mechanism:

  • Scrapes and parses the active modulus from gcaptcha4.js dynamically.
  • Maintains an internal cache (keyring).
  • If GeeTest returns error -50002 or -50003 (RSA decryption failed), PyPasser automatically fetches the updated key and retries the request seamlessly.

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause GeeTestError Base exception for GeeTest errors (e.g., unsupported risk_type). GeeTestSolveFailed Challenge failed verification or attempts were exhausted. RequestRateLimited GeeTest CDN returned HTTP 429 or 5xx across all mirrors. RequestFailed Network or HTTP connection error.

docs.title: Lemin Cropped CAPTCHA
docs.text:
Lemin Cropped CAPTCHA is an interactive jigsaw puzzle challenge where users drag one or more cutout puzzle pieces into matching empty slots on a background scene.

PyPasser solves Lemin Cropped challenges in a few seconds over pure HTTP without opening a browser or rendering JavaScript.

docs.title: How PyPasser Solves Lemin (Pure HTTP)
docs.text:
The entire Lemin solving flow consists of three lightweight HTTP requests:

  1. Fetch Challenge URL: Calls GET https://api.leminnow.com/captcha/v1/cropped/{captcha_id}/image/{challenge_id} signed with an MD5 widget signature (lsign). The response yields the scene image URL and layout metadata (url|caption|layout).
  2. Local Computer Vision: Downloads the raw PNG scene and uses Canny edge detection and template correlation to locate the exact pixel coordinates of the cutout slot.
  3. Trajectory Generation & Pre-Validation: Synthesizes a natural, human-like mouse drag trajectory with micro-jitter, encodes the path in base32, and calls POST https://api.leminnow.com/captcha/v1/cropped/pre-validate to obtain a valid pv_token.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
Lemin requires the [vision] extra for image processing and edge detection:

pip install "PyPasser[vision]"

docs.title: Quick Example (Sync)
docs.text:
from pypasser.captcha import lemin

result = lemin.solve(
    captcha_id="CROPPED_3dfdd5c_d1872b526b794d83ba3b365eb15a200b",
    domain="https://2captcha.com",
)

if result.is_solved:
    data = result.response_token
    print("Pre-validation Token:", data["pv_token"])
    print("Answer Trajectory:", data["answer"][:30], "...")
    print("Challenge ID:", data["challenge_id"])

from pypasser.captcha import lemin

async def main():
    result = await lemin.asolve(
        captcha_id="CROPPED_3dfdd5c_d1872b526b794d83ba3b365eb15a200b",
        domain="https://2captcha.com",
    )
    if result.is_solved:
        print("Async Token:", result.response_token["pv_token"])

asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: Browser Automation Injection
docs.text: When automating a web page with Playwright or Selenium, you do not need to let the browser drag the puzzle piece. Instead, solve headlessly with PyPasser and inject the tokens into Lemin's hidden form inputs:

docs.title: Playwright Injection Example
docs.text:
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import lemin

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/lemin")

    # 1. Solve headlessly via HTTP
    result = lemin.solve(
        captcha_id="CROPPED_3dfdd5c_d1872b526b794d83ba3b365eb15a200b",
        domain="https://2captcha.com",
    )

    data = result.response_token

    # 2. Inject answer and challenge_id into hidden inputs
    page.evaluate(
        """({ answer, challenge_id }) => {
            const elAns = document.querySelector('input[name="lemin_answer"]') ||
                          document.querySelector('#LCanswer');
            const elCid = document.querySelector('input[name="lemin_challenge_id"]') ||
                          document.querySelector('#LCchallenge_id');
            if (elAns) elAns.value = answer;
            if (elCid) elCid.value = challenge_id;
        }""",
        {"answer": data["answer"], "challenge_id": data["challenge_id"]},
    )

    # 3. Submit form or trigger verify button
    page.locator("button[type='submit']").click()
    browser.close()

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause LeminError Base exception for all Lemin solving errors. LeminSolveFailed Puzzle cutout could not be identified by CV, pre-validation was rejected, or multi-piece challenge requested. RequestFailed Network transport error or image download failure.

docs.title: reCAPTCHA V2
docs.text:
reCAPTCHA V2 is Google's interactive challenge presenting either a checkbox ("I'm not a robot") or image tile grids.

PyPasser solves reCAPTCHA V2 challenges using an offline audio recognition pipeline:

  1. Clicks the "I'm not a robot" checkbox iframe.
  2. If an image challenge appears, clicks the audio challenge button (headphone icon).
  3. Downloads the audio challenge clip (.mp3).
  4. Converts audio to PCM using imageio-ffmpeg / pydub.
  5. Transcribes the spoken digits locally with Vosk (offline speech recognition).
  6. Enters the text into the answer box and verifies.

Supports Checkbox, Invisible, Callback, and Enterprise variants.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
V2 audio solving requires browser automation and speech packages:

pip install "PyPasser[stealth,speech]"
patchright install chromium

docs.title: Quick Example (Sync)
docs.text:
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import recaptcha

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/recaptcha-v2")

    # Solve the challenge on the current page
    result = recaptcha.v2.solve(page)

    if result.is_solved:
        print("Success! Token:", result.response_token)
        # Token is already populated in document.querySelector('#g-recaptcha-response')
        page.locator("button[type='submit']").click()

    browser.close()

        page = await browser.new_page()

  • response_token: String containing the g-recaptcha-response value.

docs.title: Invisible reCAPTCHA
docs.text:
Invisible reCAPTCHA has no initial checkbox. It triggers on button click or form submit. First trigger the challenge, then call solve():

# Click the form submit button that invokes grecaptcha.execute()
page.locator("#submit-button").click()

# PyPasser detects and solves the popup challenge frame
result = recaptcha.v2.solve(page)

docs.title: Callback reCAPTCHA
docs.text: When reCAPTCHA defines a data-callback function, PyPasser automatically calls the callback after solving so client-side listeners execute properly.

docs.title: Bot Detection & IP Blocks
docs.text:
Google actively monitors IP reputation on audio challenge endpoints. If an IP is flagged, Google shows:

"Your computer or network may be sending automated queries. To protect our users, we can't process your request right now."

When this occurs, PyPasser raises pypasser.exceptions.IpBlock.

docs.title: How to avoid IP blocks:
docs.text:
1. Use Patchright: Always use patchright instead of standard playwright (pip install "PyPasser[stealth]").
  2. High-Reputation Residential Proxies: Data center IPs are frequently pre-flagged by Google.
  3. Headful mode: Headed browsers have substantially lower block rates than headless browsers.

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause IpBlock Google blocked the IP address from requesting audio challenges. RecaptchaResponseNotFound Audio download link could not be located, or response token missing. AudioDecodeError Challenge audio could not be decoded to PCM format. UnknownBackend Could not determine the browser adapter type from page. BackendNotAsync Attempted asolve() with a synchronous Playwright page instance.

docs.title: reCAPTCHA V3
docs.text:
reCAPTCHA V3 is a score-based risk analysis CAPTCHA from Google. Unlike V2, it runs silently in the background without user interaction.

PyPasser supports two modes for reCAPTCHA V3:

  1. Pure HTTP Mode (Recommended): Solves reCAPTCHA V3 entirely over HTTP requests using an anchor URL. Fast, lightweight, and requires no browser.
  2. Page Mode: Attaches to an active Playwright page and waits for #g-recaptcha-response to populate in the DOM.

Supports both Standard (/api2/anchor) and Enterprise (/enterprise/anchor) endpoints.

docs.title: Quick Example (Pure HTTP)
docs.text:
from pypasser.captcha import recaptcha

result = recaptcha.v3.solve(
    anchor_url="https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor?ar=1&k=6LdyC2cUAAAAACGuDK2VJzwkaoq2M9vg2qW6yO0u&co=aHR0cHM6Ly8yY2FwdGNoYS5jb206NDQz&hl=en&v=1&size=invisible&cb=123"
)

if result.is_solved:
    token = result.response_token
    print("g-recaptcha-response token:", token)

docs.title: How to Get the Anchor URL
docs.text:
In your browser developer tools:

  1. Open the Network tab.
  2. Filter requests by anchor.
  3. Locate the URL starting with https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor (or /enterprise/anchor).
  4. Copy the entire URL including all query parameters (k, co, v, size, etc.).

docs.title: solve()
docs.text:
def solve(
    first: Any = None,
    *,
    anchor_url: Optional[str] = None,
    page: Any = None,
    proxy: Optional[str] = None,
    timeout: Union[int, float] = 20,
) -> SolverResult: ...

docs.title: asolve()
docs.text:
async def asolve(
    first: Any = None,
    *,
    anchor_url: Optional[str] = None,
    page: Any = None,
    proxy: Optional[str] = None,
    timeout: Union[int, float] = 20,
) -> SolverResult: ...

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Default Description first Any None Convenience positional parameter. If a str, treated as anchor_url. If an object, treated as page. anchor_url str \| None None Full anchor URL copied from the reCAPTCHA iframe src. page Page \| None None Playwright or Patchright Page object displaying the site. proxy str \| None None Proxy URL string (http://, socks5://). Only applies in HTTP mode. timeout int \| float 20 HTTP request timeout in seconds (HTTP mode) or DOM token polling timeout (Page mode).

docs.title: Return Value
docs.text:
Returns a SolverResult where:

  • is_solved: True if a token was obtained.
  • response_token: String containing the g-recaptcha-response token.

docs.title: Dynamic Render Version Syncing
docs.text:
Google periodically updates its client-side JavaScript bundles (api.js, enterprise.js), which changes the internal render version query parameter (v). If a solver hardcodes an old version, Google assigns the token a lower risk score or rejects it.

PyPasser automatically fetches Google's active render version and caches it for 1 hour:

from pypasser.captcha.recaptcha.v3.render import latest_render_version, alatest_render_version

# Fetches and caches the current Google v parameter (e.g., '1P_fl286-9...'):
v = latest_render_version("https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js")

docs.title: Page Mode Example (Playwright)
docs.text:
If the target site triggers reCAPTCHA V3 dynamically upon form submission, use Page mode:

from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import recaptcha

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/recaptcha-v3")

    # Pass the Page object to extract the token directly from the DOM:
    result = recaptcha.v3.solve(page=page, timeout=15)
    print("Extracted token:", result.response_token)

    browser.close()

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause InvalidAnchorURL Anchor URL missing required k (site key) or co (origin hash) parameters, or both anchor_url and page were omitted. RecaptchaTokenNotFound Anchor response did not contain the hidden initial recaptcha-token. RecaptchaResponseNotFound Reload call did not return rresp, or Page mode timed out waiting for DOM element. RequestFailed Network or HTTP transport error.

docs.title: Cloudflare Turnstile
docs.text:
Cloudflare Turnstile is Cloudflare's smart CAPTCHA alternative. It runs non-interactive checks in the background or presents an interactive checkbox widget.

PyPasser automates Turnstile widgets by locating the embedded iframe, clicking the checkbox with natural delays, and waiting for the token to be issued into the DOM.

docs.title: Installation Requirement
docs.text:
Turnstile requires a browser automation engine. For best stealth performance against Cloudflare's bot heuristics, we strongly recommend Patchright:

pip install "PyPasser[stealth]"
patchright install chromium

docs.title: Quick Example (Sync)
docs.text:
from patchright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import turnstile

with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/cloudflare-turnstile")

    # Solves Turnstile on the page
    result = turnstile.solve(page)

    if result.is_solved:
        print("Turnstile token:", result.response_token)
        # Form can now be submitted
        page.locator("button[type='submit']").click()

    browser.close()

docs.title: Quick Example (Async)
docs.text:
import asyncio
from patchright.async_api import async_playwright
from pypasser.captcha import turnstile

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as pw:
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto("https://2captcha.com/demo/cloudflare-turnstile")

        result = await turnstile.asolve(page)
        if result.is_solved:
            print("Turnstile token:", result.response_token)

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())

docs.text:
def solve(
    page: Any,
    backend: str = "auto",
    attempts: int = 3,
    timeout: float = 30,
) -> SolverResult: ...

docs.title: asolve()
docs.text:
async def asolve(
    page: Any,
    backend: str = "auto",
    attempts: int = 3,
    timeout: float = 30,
) -> SolverResult: ...

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Type Default Description page Page Required Playwright or Patchright Page object displaying the Turnstile challenge. backend str "auto" Browser automation backend: "auto", "playwright", or "patchright". attempts int 3 Maximum number of checkbox click attempts if the widget re-renders. timeout float 30 Maximum polling duration in seconds to wait for widget completion.

docs.title: Return Value
docs.text:
Returns a SolverResult where:

  • is_solved: True when the token is ready.
  • response_token: String containing the cf-turnstile-response token read from input[name="cf-turnstile-response"].
  • cookies: If solving a standalone challenge page, includes the active cookies.
  • user_agent: User-Agent string of the browser context.

docs.title: Headless vs Headed Modes
docs.text:
Cloudflare actively fingerpaints headless browsers. When running in a headless environment:

  • Standard Playwright headless (headless=True) is frequently blocked or fails to pass Turnstile.
  • Patchright or Camoufox can pass Turnstile headlessly on clean IP addresses.
  • If you encounter recurring failures, launch the browser with headless=False.

docs.title: Exceptions
docs.text: Exception Cause UnknownBackend Could not determine the browser adapter type from page. BackendNotAsync Attempted asolve() using a synchronous Playwright page instance.
